title: Multicenter retrospective analysis of neurosarcoidosis
summary:
Neurosarcoidosis is a rare form of sarcoidosis in which the nervous system is affected. The disease can follow very different courses and may, for example, affect nerves, the brain, or the spinal cord. Because the disease is rare, only limited information is currently available about its course and treatment.

The aim of this study is to investigate neurosarcoidosis in as many affected patients as possible. In particular, different disease courses, symptoms, examination findings, and treatments will be recorded. The study will also investigate which factors are associated with a more favorable or less favorable disease course and with response to treatment.

For this purpose, existing information from patients’ medical records at the participating hospitals will be analyzed retrospectively. Information on symptoms and disease course, results of blood and cerebrospinal fluid tests, medical imaging, as well as treatments given and their effectiveness will be collected. No additional examinations or treatments will be performed as part of the study. Before the data are used for the multicenter analysis, they will be processed so that individual patients cannot be identified by the center conducting the analysis.

interventions.name:
This is a multicenter retrospective observational study. Patients with a diagnosis of neurosarcoidosis will be included if clinical routine data are available from the participating centers for the period from January 1, 2000, until September 22, 2026.
